name: Deviate Eradication
summary: In the Wailing Caverns, Ebru sends you to thin the deviate beasts. The night elf druid watches over the caverns while other disciples try to wake Naralex. His twisted vision has spawned mutated creatures whose numbers threaten to carry corruption beyond the underground springs and into the Barrens.

sections.title: A Dream Gone Terribly Wrong
sections.body: Naralex brought his followers to the Barrens' underground springs, hoping to draw on the Emerald Dream and restore the dry plains as woodland. Instead, the Dream ensnared him, and his sleep turned to nightmare. Power coursing through the caverns warped native plants and animals into aggressive mutants called deviate beasts.

sections.title: Ebru's Stand
sections.body: Ebru watches from a cliffside cave above the entrance with the few Disciples of Naralex who remain. Their numbers dwindle. Some work to wake their fallen leader, but Ebru sees danger in the deviate vipers, shamblers, ravagers, and dreadfangs. They multiply quickly and may spread into the Barrens. So Ebru asks you to enter the deep tunnels and cull the monsters at their source.

faq.q: Where do I find Ebru to start this quest?
faq.answer: Ebru waits with a few other Disciples of Naralex in a secluded cave high above the Wailing Caverns' main entrance. The cave lies in what looks like the right eye socket of the skull-shaped rock. Climb around the mountain ridge, then carefully descend to the upper ledge.

faq.q: What caused the beasts to become deviate?
aliases: what corrupted the animals in wc
faq.answer: The beasts changed when Naralex's effort to renew the Barrens went wrong. He linked his mind to the underground springs and the Emerald Dream, but a nightmare seized his thoughts and twisted the restorative power into a force that mutates local wildlife.

faq.q: Who are the Disciples of Naralex?
aliases: who are the druids in wailing caverns
faq.answer: The Disciples of Naralex are druids who followed him to the Wailing Caverns to help restore the Barrens. After the Nightmare trapped Naralex, many disciples became feral or lost their minds. Only a small remnant remains sane and tries to undo the disaster.

faq.q: Can Alliance and Horde both take this quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Ebru and the druids with her seek to preserve nature and contain the Nightmare. They accept help from capable champions of either the Horde or the Alliance.

faq.q: What creatures do you have to slay for Ebru?
faq.answer: Ebru asks you to hunt four kinds of corrupted creatures deep in the caverns: Deviate Ravagers, Deviate Vipers, Deviate Shamblers, and Deviate Dreadfangs. You must slay seven of each.

faq.q: Does completing this quest wake Naralex?
faq.answer: No. Ebru asks you to thin the dangerous beasts and limit the damage they cause. Waking Naralex takes a separate ritual deep in his sanctum at the heart of the cavern.

angles.text: As a druid, the twisted life in the caverns warns what can happen when communion with the Emerald Dream goes wrong.
As a member of the Horde, you can help protect nearby settlements such as the Crossroads by culling the predators in the Wailing Caverns, at the heart of Kalimdor's central plains.
As a night elf, you may feel bound to aid your stranded kin as Naralex's noble hope becomes a nightmare-born horror.
